title: Company Funding News Press Signal Scanner input
description: Scan public news and press sources for a company's funding rounds, exec moves, product launches, and acquisitions. Free Apify-plan users get 100 results per calendar month (resets monthly); upgrade for unlimited: https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=mamba

domain.title: Company domain
domain.description: Company domain to scan, without https or www, e.g. stripe.com. This is the main input for single-company runs and for Clay per-row enrichment.

company_name.title: Company name (optional hint)
company_name.description: Optional search hint. Improves matching when the domain does not match the brand name, e.g. domain deel.com with name Deel. Only applied on single-company runs.

domains.title: Company domains (batch)
domains.description: Optional list of domains for batch runs. When set and non-empty, this overrides the single domain field. Leave empty for single-company or Clay per-row use.

signal_types.title: Signal Types
signal_types.description: Report only these event types. Leave empty for every type, which is what the actor has always done. Narrowing also narrows the search: a funding only run issues one news query instead of four.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: How far back to search, in days. Default 365. A shorter window surfaces only fresh news, which is what a trigger based campaign wants.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
